persona: WebLogic administrator in a banking IT services team with shell scripting only listed
resumeText:
Arvind Kulkarni | Pune | arvind.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Middleware Administrator, Sahyadri Infotech Services, Pune (Apr 2021 - present)
- Administer Oracle WebLogic 12c domains and clusters for 30 banking applications.
- Deploy EAR and WAR releases using WLST scripts during weekend change windows.
- Configure Apache HTTP Server and Tomcat as reverse proxies in front of WebLogic managed servers.
- Renew SSL certificates and update Java keystores before expiry across 120 servers.
- Take thread dumps and heap dumps to troubleshoot stuck threads and memory issues.
- Raise change requests and handle P2 incidents in ServiceNow following ITIL processes.

Associate System Engineer, Sahyadri Infotech Services, Pune (Aug 2019 - Mar 2021)
- Monitored Red Hat Linux servers and checked application logs, disk usage and running processes.
- Applied quarterly Oracle patches to WebLogic test environments under senior guidance.

EDUCATION
BE Computer Engineering, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2019

SKILLS
WebLogic, Tomcat, Apache, Linux, Shell scripting, ServiceNow
